description: Bureau of Meteorology ACCESS-S calibrated NEAR-TERM rainfall outlook — the next two weeks and two overlapping fortnights (covering ~4 weeks out) — point-queried at the same inflow-catchment and irrigation-district sites as the seasonal snapshot. Probabilistic BOM forecast, not a Waterfind prediction. The shortest period is a WEEK: no day-by-day forecast exists in this dataset.

reading_guide.chance_unusually_dry_pct: Probability the period lands in the driest fifth of the historical record for that week/fortnight of the year. The climatological baseline is 20% by construction.
reading_guide.exceedance_percentiles: wet_case (25% chance of exceeding) is HIGHER than dry_case (75% chance of exceeding) — both are named for the exceedance probability, not the distribution percentile.
reading_guide.past_accuracy: BOM weighted-percent-correct hindcast score at this lead and location; ~50% is chance level. Multi-week accuracy is generally higher than seasonal at week 1 and decays fast by week 2+.
reading_guide.no_daily_detail: The shortest period is a week. Questions about a specific day cannot be answered from this dataset — say so rather than interpolating.
reading_guide.odds_multiples_are_not_amounts: *_odds_multiple_vs_normal fields are dimensionless multiples of the 20% climatological baseline, not mm and not degrees.

past_accuracy.basis: BOM past accuracy (weighted percent correct): % of years 1981-2018 the model correctly called above/below median at this location and lead, weighted by how far observations were from median. ~50% = no better than chance. BOM's own bands: <=45 very low, 45-55 low, 55-65 moderate, 65-75 high, >75 very high.

BOM past accuracy (weighted percent correct): % of years 1981-2018 the model correctly called above/below median at this location and lead, weighted by how far observations were from median. ~50% = no better than chance. BOM's own bands: <=45 very low, 45-55 low, 55-65 moderate, 65-75 high, >75 very high.

gaps: mm totals only for the first period of each length (weekly/fortnightly/fourweekly); the WMS ignores TIME on the scenario files.
The value endpoint is undocumented internal plumbing and can change without notice.
